input.prompt: Clean flat vector infographic for a website, wide landscape composition on a pure white background, corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, matching a light blue and yellow illustration set. Show the three kinds of documents that automated data extraction handles as a single horizontal row of three identical wide rounded-rectangle tiles with even gutters, all three tiles with exactly the same pale blue #E7F0FB fill and no highlighted, selected, darker or lighter tile. Each tile has one short bold navy title centered at the top in a clean sans-serif font, a row of three simple line-and-fill icons in the middle, and nothing else. Icons contain no lettering and no small text. Tile 1 title exactly 'Structured': icons of a spreadsheet grid, a form with checkboxes, and a database table. Tile 2 title exactly 'Semi-structured': icons of a paper invoice with a table, an insurance claims form with a clipboard, and a purchase order with a stamp. Tile 3 title exactly 'Unstructured': icons of an email envelope, a contract page with a signature line, and a handwritten note with a pen. Under the row of tiles, a single thick periwinkle-blue arrow points down to one centered rounded pill labelled exactly 'Clean, validated data' with a small green check mark icon beside the words, and a small database cylinder icon. A single small yellow spark near the top-right corner. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, navy #1F2A44, soft green #3BB273, white. Generous outer margins, crisp edges, no dotted lines. The only text in the image is 'Structured', 'Semi-structured', 'Unstructured' and 'Clean, validated data', all bold and perfectly spelled with clear padding.
